limits: Stock 1991 US-market 325i two-door body with separate late-style bumpers, doors, glass, and narrow quarter panels. The left-hand-drive cabin shows comfort seats, airbag wheel, five-speed shifter and power sunroof. Overall body dimensions and axle positions follow BMW’s 325i owner’s handbook. Individual surfaces and mechanical details are modeled from photos and catalog diagrams. The Getrag 260 has sectional and exploded views based on BMW drawings. Gear teeth and individual mechanical dimensions are illustrative. Use your catalog and manual to identify parts and service the car. Battery details follow the cited stock layout and catalog; case dimensions, cable routing and installed clearances remain illustrative. The trunk and rear-seat trim use the catalog layout and this model’s panel and seat anchors. Factory hole spacing and clearances are unmeasured. Front cabin fastener axes are aligned to the modeled seats and trim. Factory hole spacing, trim options and installed clearances have not been measured. Roof trim follows the existing model surfaces and catalog diagrams. Physical mounting positions and installed clearances have not been measured. Floor and restraint geometry follows the reference body and BMW catalog. Physical mounting dimensions and belt operation have not been measured. HVAC housings and duct routes are diagram-based. Confirm the fitted climate system before ordering. Physical dimensions and airflow have not been measured.
